findings.F1: The coin's last one-day return predicts the next 7 days in the same direction. The pooled OLS slope of the 7-day forward return minus the coin's mean, on the per-coin standardised 1-day return, is 0.0107 per standard deviation (t = 2.79, n = 767 non-overlapping cases, BTC and ETH). By quintile, the lowest 1-day return quintile is followed by −2.01% (t = −2.29) and the top two quintiles by +1.16% and +1.17%. The same return scaled by its own 60-day volatility keeps the sign (slope 0.0082, t = 2.02, n = 671).
findings.F2: The tested RSI-above-midline share gives a graded but weaker version of this momentum. Its quintiles run from −0.66% to +1.15% excess 7-day return, with pooled t = 1.73 (n = 815). The 14-day return gives t = 1.60 (n = 719), the 3-day return t = 0.72, and the 60-day return t = −0.13 (n = 383). The information sits in the most recent moves, not in long trends.
findings.F3: The book's gain comes from being long in coins whose 60-day return is positive. The mean daily gain there is 0.00305 (t = 3.71, n = 1231). Longs in falling coins earn −0.00218 (t = −1.43, n = 226) and shorts earn about nothing overall (0.000071 per day, n = 2784). Since the 60-day return does not predict excess 7-day returns (t = −0.13), this is the coins' own rise, not timing.
findings.F4: Inside 60-day up and down trends, the share's slope on the excess 7-day return has opposite signs and is not significant either way: +0.021 (t = 0.92, n = 208) and −0.020 (t = −0.63, n = 175). The trend regime does not sharpen the RSI effect.
findings.F5: The weekday effects do not hold across the two halves of the years. Thursday and Friday next-day returns have t = 2.41 and 2.72 in the earlier years but t = −0.10 and 0.47 in the later ones. Only Tuesday is positive in both halves (t = 1.44 and 2.16). Volatility level (14-day vol quintiles, all |t| < 0.9) and bar range show no graded link to later returns.

ideas.idea: The larger a coin's one-day return relative to its own recent 60-day daily volatility, the larger its move in the same direction over the next 7 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader would lean with the most recent day's outsized move for the following week rather than wait for a multi-week RSI regime to form.
ideas.name: one-day move continues weekly
